goal: Determine when deterministic wait, early threshold, or SG055 ranking minimize modelled loss as false-direction, abstain and observation costs vary; no oracle in action selection.

data.generator: Frozen SG052 simultaneous sign/noise transition model; 27 sign-pair/noise combinations

policy_lock: Use SG055 original training seed 197000000, 20/configuration, original 90/150/18/.06 cost table for authorization, no re-training per scenario cost. Actions fixed and evaluated at each stress-grid cell.
selection: For each loss cell select single least observed holdout total loss; tie resolve SG052_wait then SG054_threshold4 then SG055_ranked. This is retrospective evaluation, not an online oracle policy.
reports: Loss of all 3 policies in 27 cells
Policy winner frequency and worst regret
Central cost setting and paired stream error counts
Stability of preference over cost grid
acceptance: Freeze then execute fresh holdout, archive full per-stream decision ledger, SHA256, index, phase tracker at 58.3%. Mark result mixed or negative when appropriate.
caveats: Choosing the best policy after seeing heldout labels is not a validated deployable controller.
Same generator family; new holdout seeds only.
The original SG055 policy action table must not change across stress grid.
